notes.text: Available in cPanel 11.42 and later; uses the selected account context. No request arguments or defaults are declared in the pinned operation.
Returns the server SSH port as an optional integer. Reading the port does not connect to SSH or establish SSH availability.

The original security-access capture on cPanel 11.138.0.19 observed numeric-string port values through both routes. Only canonical strings that round-trip within the PHP integer range normalize to integers; alternate spellings, fractions and overflow remain rejected. Structural evidence does not establish the exact string spelling. Omitted port stays omitted; no null is inferred.

Returns optional boolean has_terminal_access and optional string shell for the selected account. Preserve false and empty strings separately from omission; integer 0/1 flags are not booleans for this response. This read does not open a shell or establish successful SSH authentication.
